Name: La+ Darknesss
Groups: hololive, Secret Society holoX, holoX, NePoX
Other Names: La+, Laplus, YMD, ラプラス・ダークネス
Personality: La+ is the founder of Secret Society holoX. Her official profile makes her a demon whose once-vast power and intelligence are sealed by shackles she cannot remember receiving, with a crow as her long-time companion. She plays the overlord: she calls herself "wagahai" (an arrogant, archaic "I") and others "kisama," plots world domination, and her followers answer her call with "Yes My Dark!" She is a smug, bratty little boss whom seniors tease as one of hololive's "babies," a label she refuses, and she edits her own highlight clips. Between villain set pieces she chats casually with chat. She is quick and funny: when fans voted on their name she split the joke option "Yamada" between two choices, and Plusmate won. She takes her music seriously.
Background: La+ is an active member of Secret Society holoX. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2021-11-26 as the first member of Secret Society holoX, hololive's sixth Japanese generation, whose executive officer Takane Lui does the actual running. Her songs include "drop candy" (2024) and "Onee-sama♡Love Call" (released 2026-05-26). She performed at holoX's first in-person unit concert, "First MISSION" (2026-04-29), and Tochigi Prefecture appointed her a Tochigi Future Ambassador (2026-05-03). With the English cast: the Mythmash single "Glow in the Dark" (released 2025-07-28) and the cover "FAKE HEART" (2025) with Takanashi Kiara, a nostalgic-games off-collab on Kiara's channel (2023), and Mori Calliope's English lesson #02 with Gawr Gura and Kazama Iroha (2022).
Physical Description: La+'s avatar is 139 cm tall, with long silvery hair, a purple lock and a braided bang, large black horns striped in purple above pointed ears, yellow eyes and small fangs. She wears a dark purple dress with a yellow tie and oversized sleeves that swallow her hands, one purple legging and short boots, with a star-tipped purple tail and shackles at her neck, sleeves and ankles. A crow keeps her company. Other outfits in the official gallery: Kimono: twin braided tails tied with big gold bells, a black-and-purple kimono with manga-panel prints and flowers, a purple obi; Streetwear: a cross-shaped clip, a black oversized jacket with purple flame patterns over a white shirt with a purple tie, a purple plaid skirt and black thigh-high boots; Sporty outfit: purple-tipped twin tails, a white-and-purple cropped jacket with a sailor collar over a white crop top, black shorts; Shackled robe: short twin tails, banded horns, a black tunic with a long patterned front panel; Knit-and-plaid outfit: a black cat-ear knit beanie under her horns, a black oversized cardigan with purple plaid bows over a black shirt-dress, a chain bag.
Dialogue Style: Streams in Japanese. Her persona voice is a pint-sized villain: an archaic 「吾輩」 (wagahai) for "I," 「貴様」 (kisama) for "you," and grand declarations that her followers answer with "Yes My Dark!" She opens casually as often as grandly, and her sign-off often gets cut off mid-word as the stream ends. Between declarations she chats casually: 「聞こえたっしょ」 (kikoeta ssho, "you heard it, right?") checks with chat, and she shows off about being a real streamer. When a story renders her speech in English or Chinese, keep the archaic villain "I" (in Chinese, 吾輩) for persona moments against a small, indignant voice.
Catchphrases: 「貴様ら、刮目せよ！！」 ("Kisama-ra, katsumoku seyo!!"; official introduction, officially "See me, hear me, all of you!"); 「吾輩だ、刮目せよ」 ("Wagahai da, katsumoku seyo," "it is I, behold," a casual opening; also 「刮目刮目〜」); 「来る時に備えよ！」 ("Kitaru toki ni sonaeyo!", "Prepare for the time to come!", her sign-off); "Yes My Dark!" (her followers' answer, not her line); 「吾輩」 (wagahai, her persona "I"); 「貴様」 (kisama, "you"); 「吾輩怪しい者でないぞ」 ("Wagahai ayashii mono de nai zo," "I'm not a suspicious person!," from her first post); 「これが配信者よ」 ("this is what a streamer is!"). Her full title: "Laplus Dia Highest Death Thirteen Daina Art of Impact Sign Emperor Road of the Darknesss." Her fans are the Plusmate (ぷらすめいと, +mate).
